steps.name: environment - verify base tools and install Python packages
steps.description: Verify python3 and pip, ensure zip/unzip present (install only if missing), install openpyxl via python3 -m pip only (avoid unguarded pip upgrade). Optionally install pywin32 only if INSTALL_PYWIN32=1 and running on Windows host (the script will warn if not). Creates workspace dir early and checks permissions. Prints explicit versions for python, pip, openpyxl, node and npm for CI evidence. Uses CONTAINER_WORKSPACE (/home/kavia/.../ATS_OptimizedResumeApplication) as workspace.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS_PATH="${CONTAINER_WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ats-optimized-resume-with-modern-ui-design-21417-21530/ATS_OptimizedResumeApplication}"
# ensure workspace exists early and is writable
mkdir -p "$WS_PATH" || { echo "ERROR: cannot create workspace $WS_PATH" >&2; exit 20; }
[ -w "$WS_PATH" ] || { echo "ERROR: workspace $WS_PATH not writable" >&2; exit 21; }
# basic runtime checks
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: python3 not found" >&2; exit 22; }
python3 -m pip --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: pip (python3 -m pip) not available" >&2; exit 23; }
# ensure zip/unzip present (install only missing) but surface apt errors if they occur
MISSING=()
command -v zip >/dev/null 2>&1 || MISSING+=(zip)
command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1 || MISSING+=(unzip)
if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -ne 0 ]; then sudo apt-get update -qq || { echo "ERROR: apt-get update failed" >&2; exit 24; }; sudo apt-get install -y -qq "${MISSING[@]}" || { echo "ERROR: apt-get install ${MISSING[*]} failed" >&2; exit 25; }; fi
# pip operations: avoid unguarded pip upgrade. Upgrade pip only if UPGRADE_PIP=1
if [ "${UPGRADE_PIP:-0}" = "1" ]; then python3 -m pip install --no-input --quiet --upgrade pip || { echo 'ERROR: pip upgrade failed' >&2; exit 26; }; fi
# install openpyxl idempotently
python3 -m pip install --no-input --quiet openpyxl || { echo 'ERROR: pip install openpyxl failed' >&2; exit 27; }
# optional pywin32: warn if attempted in Linux
if [ "${INSTALL_PYWIN32:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  if [ "$(uname -s)" != "Linux" ]; then
    python3 -m pip install --no-input --quiet pywin32 || { echo 'ERROR: pip install pywin32 failed' >&2; exit 28; }
  else
    echo "WARN: INSTALL_PYWIN32=1 but host is Linux; pywin32 is Windows-only - skip install" >&2
  fi
fi
# print versions for CI
python3 - <<PY
import sys
try:
    import openpyxl, sys
    print('openpyxl', openpyxl.__version__)
except Exception as e:
    print('ERROR: openpyxl import failed:', e, file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(29)
PY
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node -v || true
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm -v || true

steps.name: dependencies - optional office-js tooling and packaging script
steps.description: Install optional office-js tooling in an idempotent and controlled way. By default prefer npx/local usage (no global npm -g). Controls: INSTALL_OFFICEJS=1 to enable; OFFICE_ADDIN_CLI_VERSION to pin; OFFICE_ADDIN_GLOBAL=1 to allow global install. If global install is chosen, write /etc/profile.d only when writable and guarded; otherwise create a workspace-local wrapper (workspace/.env.d/officejs_path.sh) and document it. Generate scripts/package_xlsm.sh that computes workspace at runtime (so no heredoc variable injection bug) and validate the script with bash -n before making executable.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS_PATH="${CONTAINER_WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ats-optimized-resume-with-modern-ui-design-21417-21530/ATS_OptimizedResumeApplication}"
cd "$WS_PATH"
# evidence
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node -v || true
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm -v || true
# optionally install office-addin-cli: prefer npx/local unless OFFICE_ADDIN_GLOBAL=1
if [ "${INSTALL_OFFICEJS:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  CLI_VER="${OFFICE_ADDIN_CLI_VERSION:-latest}"
  if [ "${OFFICE_ADDIN_GLOBAL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    # check existing version and skip if matches/pinned
    if command -v office-addin >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v office-addin-cli >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo 'office-addin present; skipping global install'
    else
      sudo npm i -g --no-audit --silent "office-addin-cli@${CLI_VER}" || { echo 'ERROR: npm -g install office-addin-cli failed' >&2; exit 40; }
      NPM_G_BIN=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || true)
      if [ -n "$NPM_G_BIN" ]; then
        PROFILE_FILE=/etc/profile.d/officejs_path.sh
        ENTRY="export PATH=\"${NPM_G_BIN}:\$PATH\""
        # ensure we can write the profile file atomically
        if sudo test -w /etc/profile.d/ 2>/dev/null || sudo test -f "$PROFILE_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "$ENTRY" | sudo tee "$PROFILE_FILE" >/dev/null && sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE_FILE" || { echo 'ERROR: failed to write /etc/profile.d entry' >&2; exit 41; }
        else
          # fallback to workspace-local wrapper
          mkdir -p "$WS_PATH/.env.d" && echo "$ENTRY" > "$WS_PATH/.env.d/officejs_path.sh"
        fi
      fi
    fi
  else
    # prefer npx or local install: create helper script to use npx
    mkdir -p "$WS_PATH/.env.d"
    echo "# helper to run office-addin-cli via npx (no global install)" > "$WS_PATH/.env.d/officejs_npx.sh"
    echo "run_office_addin_cli() { npx --yes --package office-addin-cli${CLI_VER:+@${CLI_VER}} office-addin \"\$@\"; }" >> "$WS_PATH/.env.d/officejs_npx.sh"
  fi
fi
# generate packaging script that computes WS at runtime (avoids injected WS_PATH bug)
cat > scripts/package_xlsm.sh <<'PKG'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# compute workspace: parent of scripts/ (assumes scripts/ lives under workspace)
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
WS="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
cd "$WS"
TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rc=$?; rm -rf "${TMP_DIR}" || true; exit ${rc}' EXIT
cp "templates/sample_template.xlsx" "${TMP_DIR}/template.xlsx" || { echo 'ERROR: templates/sample_template.xlsx not found' >&2; exit 42; }
cd "$TMP_DIR"
unzip -q template.xlsx -d unpacked || { echo 'ERROR: unzip template failed' >&2; exit 43; }
mkdir -p unpacked/xl
printf 'DUMMY VBAPROJ - placeholder; not a valid VBA binary' > unpacked/xl/vbaProject.bin
cat > unpacked/NOTICE.txt <<'NOTE'
This .xlsm was generated inside a headless Linux container as a CI placeholder. It contains a dummy vbaProject.bin and may be rejected by Excel. To embed a valid VBA project, produce vbaProject.bin from a real .xlsm on Windows and replace this file.
NOTE
cd unpacked
zip -qr "${WS}/templates/sample_template_with_vba.xlsm" . || { echo 'ERROR: zip creation failed' >&2; exit 44; }
# explicit validation: ensure produced file is a zip
unzip -l "${WS}/templates/sample_template_with_vba.xlsm" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: produced xlsm is not a valid zip' >&2; exit 45; }
PKG
# syntax check generated script
bash -n scripts/package_xlsm.sh || { echo 'ERROR: package_xlsm.sh syntax invalid' >&2; exit 46; }
chmod +x scripts/package_xlsm.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS_PATH="${CONTAINER_WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ats-optimized-resume-with-modern-ui-design-21417-21530/ATS_OptimizedResumeApplication}"
cd "$WS_PATH"
# ensure template exists
if [ ! -f templates/sample_template.xlsx ]; then echo 'ERROR: templates/sample_template.xlsx not found (scaffold may have failed)' >&2; exit 50; fi
# python-based validation: check workbook structure

from openpyxl import load_workbook
import sys
try:
    wb = load_workbook('templates/sample_template.xlsx')
except Exception as e:
    print('ERROR: failed to open templates/sample_template.xlsx:', e, file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(51)
if 'Resume' not in wb.sheetnames:
    print('ERROR: expected sheet Resume not found', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(52)
ws = wb['Resume']
if ws['A1'].value != 'Name':
    print('ERROR: templates/sample_template.xlsx A1 expected "Name"', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(53)

steps.description: Build the placeholder xlsm (package script), serve templates directory via Python HTTP server, poll until server responds with timeout, perform HTTP GET to confirm availability, capture evidence in templates/server.log, and stop server cleanly. Uses workspace path and checks curl availability but falls back to wget if curl missing. Improved polling with configurable timeout and logs for debugging.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS_PATH="${CONTAINER_WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ats-optimized-resume-with-modern-ui-design-21417-21530/ATS_OptimizedResumeApplication}"
cd "$WS_PATH"
# Build
bash scripts/package_xlsm.sh
[ -f templates/sample_template_with_vba.xlsm ] || { echo 'ERROR: build failed (missing xlsm)' >&2; exit 60; }
# ensure http client available (curl preferred, fallback to wget)
HTTP_CLIENT=none
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then HTTP_CLIENT=curl; elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then HTTP_CLIENT=wget; else echo 'ERROR: neither curl nor wget available' >&2; exit 61; fi
# Start server and redirect logs to workspace for debugging
PORT=8008
mkdir -p templates
python3 -m http.server "$PORT" --directory templates > templates/server.log 2>&1 &
PID=$!
trap 'kill ${PID} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT INT TERM
# poll until server responds or timeout
TIMEOUT=${VALIDATION_TIMEOUT:-10}
SLEEP=0.5
COUNT=0
HTTP_STATUS=0
while [ $COUNT -lt $((TIMEOUT / SLEEP + 1)) ]; do
  if [ "$HTTP_CLIENT" = "curl" ]; then
    HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/sample_template_with_vba.xlsm || true)
  else
    HTTP_STATUS=$(wget -q --spider --server-response http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/sample_template_with_vba.xlsm 2>&1 | awk '/HTTP\//{print $2; exit}' || true)
  fi
  if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" = "200" ]; then break; fi
  sleep $SLEEP
  COUNT=$((COUNT+1))
done
if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" != "200" ]; then echo "ERROR: http serve failed status=$HTTP_STATUS; see templates/server.log" >&2; kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit 62; fi
echo "VALIDATION_PASSED: build and serve OK (http status=$HTTP_STATUS). Server log: $WS_PATH/templates/server.log"
# Stop server cleanly
kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 0.2
trap - EXIT INT TERM
